articles.title: La tarde más emotiva del Heliodoro despidiendo a Jesús de Miguel
articles.standfirst: El Tenerife convoca en la tarde de este sábado un solemne homenaje al delantero fallecido
articles.summary: El Tenerife convoca en la tarde de este sábado un solemne homenaje al delantero fallecido
articles.body: El Heliodoro Rodríguez López volverá a reunirse este sábado alrededor de Jesús de Miguel. Será una tarde distinta. Sin goles que celebrar, sin nada que festejar y sin el rugido habitual de la grada. Será una tarde para recordar, para agradecer y, sobre todo, para acompañar. Porque el tinerfeñismo todavía busca la manera de convivir con la ausencia de uno de los futbolistas que formaron parte de su historia más reciente. El estadio que tantas veces celebró la entrega del delantero y que lo vio convertirse en uno de los protagonistas del último ascenso a Segunda División, abrirá sus puertas para rendirle un homenaje solemne. Un encuentro marcado por el cariño y la emoción, en el que la familia blanquiazul podrá despedirse de Jesús de Miguel y compartir, una vez más, todo aquello que el fútbol les permitió vivir juntos. El acto comenzará a las 19:00 horas (18:00 hora canaria), aunque el recinto abrirá desde dos horas antes para facilitar la llegada de los asistentes. La entrada será libre hasta completar el aforo y estarán disponibles todos los accesos, con excepción de las puertas 8 y 9, donde permanece instalado el espacio de homenaje floral y velas dedicado al jugador. El club recomienda acudir con suficiente antelación. La duración prevista de la ceremonia será de aproximadamente 85 minutos y podrá seguirse también en directo a través del canal de YouTube del CD Tenerife y de Televisión Canaria La dimensión del homenaje trascenderá las fronteras del fútbol canario. Todos los clubes del fútbol profesional español estarán representados, además del Club Baloncesto La Laguna Canarias, en una muestra de solidaridad que acompañará al Tenerife y a sus aficionados en estos días de profundo dolor. Entre las presencias ya confirmadas figura la de Miguel Ángel Ramírez, presidente de la UD Las Palmas, junto al resto de la directiva y los capitanes del conjunto amarillo. También acudirán los exfutbolistas del Barcelona Asensi y Olmo, en una cita que reunirá a representantes de distintas generaciones futbolísticas y entidades de toda la geografía nacional alrededor de una misma memoria. El Heliodoro será, durante algo más de una hora, el lugar donde las palabras, los gestos y los recuerdos ocupen el espacio que antes llenaban las carreras, los remates y los goles de Demi. Allí estarán quienes compartieron con él vestuario y césped, quienes lo acompañaron desde la grada y quienes siguieron su trayectoria desde la distancia. Cada uno con su propia historia, pero unidos por el mismo sentimiento. Porque hay futbolistas que dejan goles, estadísticas y fotografías. Y hay otros que, además, dejan una huella en la gente. Jesús de Miguel fue uno de ellos. Su contribución al último ascenso a Segunda, su compromiso y los momentos de felicidad que regaló al tinerfeñismo forman ya parte de una memoria que no entiende de despedidas. Este sábado, el Tenerife volverá a encontrarse con su afición en el lugar donde tantas veces fue feliz junto a De Miguel. No será una celebración, sino un abrazo colectivo. Una oportunidad para agradecerle lo vivido y para recordar, juntos, que su nombre formará parte para siempre de la historia blanquiazul.

articles.summary: Te contamos los detalles para que puedas disfrutar del encuentro correspondiente a la jornada 12
articles.body: Espanyol y Deportivo se enfrentan en un partido correspondiente a la jornada 12 de LaLiga EA Sports. El encuentro se disputa este sábado 7 de noviembre a las 16.15 horas en el RCDE Stadium. Será un duelo en el que Sarabia se estrenará como entrenador del equipo perico, a pesar de que no pueda estar en el banquillo al arrastrar una sanción de su etapa en el Elche, de la que aún le queda un partido por cumplir. El Espanyol llega tras imponerse la pasada jornada en La Cerámica al Villarreal con Sergio García al mando. Los pericos intentarán conseguir su segunda victoria consecutiva en el campeonato, algo que no logran desde el final de la pasada temporada. El Deportivo se agarra al 'efecto Aubameyang'. El gabonés acortó los plazos de recuperación de su lesión de rodilla para reaparecer con una actuación decisiva ante Osasuna, en un encuentro en el que los gallegos se llevaron los tres puntos. El delantero ha encendido nuevamente la llama de la ilusión en el deportivismo. Ya nadie se acuerda de la mala racha de seis partidos sin ganar que enlazó el equipo gallego. El partido entre Espanyol y Deportivo se juega este sábado 7 de noviembre a las 16.15 horas. El partido entre Espanyol y Deportivo de la jornada 12 de LaLiga EA Sports se podrá ver por televisión en directo a través de DAZN. También se podrá seguir el partido a través de la narración de Radio MARCA y con los comentarios en directo de MARCA.com. Desde dos horas antes, sigue la previa y los onces. Tras el encuentro, podrás leer la crónica, las declaraciones de los protagonistas y ver el vídeo con el resumen de las mejores jugadas y los goles. El Espanyol, con 11 puntos en la clasificación, llega al partido de LaLiga EA Sports contra el Deportivo tras ganar al Villarreal (0-1) la pasada jornada. El Deportivo, con 14 puntos en la clasificación, llega al partido de LaLiga EA Sports contra el Espanyol tras ganar a Osasuna (2-1) la pasada jornada.

articles.title: Espanyol - Deportivo | Eder Sarabia, ‘ausente’ en el inicio de su proyecto: previa, análisis, pronóstico y predicción
articles.standfirst: El técnico arrastra una sanción de su etapa en el Elche y no estará en el banquillo en su primer encuentro con los pericos. Casadó adelanta plazos y regresa al conjunto gallego
articles.summary: El técnico arrastra una sanción de su etapa en el Elche y no estará en el banquillo en su primer encuentro con los pericos. Casadó adelanta plazos y regresa al conjunto gallego
articles.body: Tras ganar en La Cerámica al Villarreal de la mano de Sergio García, el Espanyol quiere prolongar las buenas sensaciones en el estreno de Eder Sarabia, que no podrá sentarse en el banquillo al arrastrar una sanción de su etapa en el Elche, de la que aún le queda un partido por cumplir. En su lugar estará este sábado su segundo, Jon López. Después de una semana de trabajo, el nuevo técnico ha tratado de implementar sus primeras ideas para ir moldeando el equipo a su antojo. Un plan que llevará un tiempo, por lo que el propio Sarabia explicaba que ahora lo más importante es ser prácticos y abordar las cosas más sencillas para tratar de lograr un buen resultado ante el Deportivo. De ganar, los pericos encadenarían dos triunfos, algo que no sucede desde el final del curso pasado. Tras vencer a Osasuna, viaja con la intención de sumar otros tres puntos que confirmen que el bache del mes de octubre está olvidado. Antonio Hidalgo va recuperando jugadores de la enfermería y cuenta con Aubameyang, que ya disputó algunos minutos ante Osasuna, con Noé Carrillo y con la gran sorpresa Marc Casadó. El catalán adelanta los plazos y podría jugar unos minutos. “Tanto Auba como Marc eran muy optimistas. Pero tenemos que tener cautela. Hay que gestionar las cargas y ver cómo vuelven, porque luego vienen temas musculares y hay que tener cuidado”, expresó Antonio Hidalgo, que también se refirió al nuevo míster del Espanyol: “Todos conocemos a Eder Sarabia y tenemos una idea en la cabeza de cómo va a jugar su equipo. Tienen una plantilla de mucho talento”. Bryan Zaragoza vs Yeremay. De su inspiración, de su desborde, puede depender el resultado del encuentro. Son jugadores con mucha clase capaces de decidir el partido con un chispazo. Ambos llevan un gol y una asistencia en lo que va de LaLiga. El Espanyol tratará de aplicarse eso de ‘a entrenador nuevo, victoria segura’. Los dos equipos vienen de ganar la pasada jornada, pero los pericos intentarán subirse a la ‘ola Sarabia’ para llevarse el triunfo.

articles.title: Un golazo de Morchiladze para consolidar el liderato del Lugo
articles.standfirst: El conjunto de Borja Fernández logra su novena victoria de la temporada, cuarta a domicilio
articles.summary: El conjunto de Borja Fernández logra su novena victoria de la temporada, cuarta a domicilio
articles.body: El CD Lugo sigue marcando el paso en el Grupo 1 de la Primera Federación. En su visita al CP Cacereño en la jornada 11, el conjunto gallego se llevó un triunfo por 0 – 1 con el sello inconfundible de los líderes: un gol en el momento preciso y una resistencia a prueba de bombas cuando el partido se le puso cuesta arriba. El resultado consolida al Lugo en lo más alto de la tabla y deja al Cacereño con la sensación amarga de haber hecho lo suficiente para, al menos, puntuar. FICHA TÉCNICA Cacereño: Diego Nieves; Iván Martínez (José Alonso, 79’), Víctor (Artola, 71’), Manolo Molina, Expósito; Runy (Luis Sánchez, 63’), Toño Calvo (Tellechea, 63’), Nico Conesa, Monerris; Iván Fernández (Sergi López, 71’) y Osama. Lugo: Embadje; Rufo, Kike Hermoso, Pol Moreno, Simón Luca; Parrilla, Ulloa (Perera, 61’); Morchiladze (Palma, 67’), Alan Godoy (Mo Dauda, 60’), Chiqui (Berzal, 91’); y Álex Costa. Gol: 0-1 (19’): Morchiladze. Árbitro: Expósito Jaramillo, del colegio andaluz. Amonestó a los locales Manolo Molina y Expósito; y a los visitantes Mo Dauda, Pol Moreno, Morchiladze y Rufo. Campo: Príncipe Felipe. Se guardó un minuto de silencio en memoria de Jesús de Miguel y las víctimas del accidente ferroviario en Urda (Toledo). Un gol tempranero que lo condicionó todo El guion se escribió pronto. En el minuto 17, Tornike Morchiladze culminó una acción iniciada por Alex Costa para adelantar al Lugo. El tanto, revisado y validado por el VAR dos minutos después, fue el único que subió al marcador en todo el encuentro y bastó para encarrilar la victoria visitante. A partir de ahí, el partido tomó el cariz que más conviene a un equipo de arriba. El Lugo se replegó, apostó por la solidez y dejó la iniciativa a un Cacereño que, pese a su empuje, se estrelló una y otra vez contra un bloque bien armado. Los extremeños incluso reclamaron un penalti en el minuto 49 que el VAR desestimó, un episodio que resume la tarde de frustración local. El relato de los datos: dominio local, eficacia visitante Las estadísticas dibujan un choque mucho más igualado de lo que sugiere el marcador, e incluso favorable al Cacereño en algunos apartados. Los locales dispararon 18 veces frente a las 13 del Lugo, firmaron 7 tiros a puerta por los 6 de su rival y dominaron el juego de córners (7 a 3). La posesión apenas se decantó hacia los gallegos (51% frente al 49%). Pero el fútbol premia la calidad de las ocasiones, no su cantidad. Ahí el Lugo fue superior: acumuló 6 ocasiones claras por tan solo 1 del Cacereño, y sus 2,15 goles esperados casi doblaron los 1,25 de los extremeños. El dato más demoledor es también el más cruel para los visitantes: fallaron 6 ocasiones manifiestas. De no haber sido tan despilfarradores, el marcador podría haber sido una goleada. El muro defensivo del Lugo quedó retratado en sus 45 despejes, frente a los 14 del Cacereño, una cifra que delata cuánto tiempo pasó el equipo defendiendo su área. Embadje, un portero en estado de gracia Si hubo un nombre propio en la portería del Lugo, ese fue Fernando Embadje. El guardameta guineano se erigió en la gran figura del partido con 7 paradas y una valoración sobresaliente de 8,6, la más alta del encuentro. Su actuación, con 5 intervenciones a disparos desde dentro del área, fue decisiva para mantener la portería a cero y neutralizar la insistencia local. Enfrente, el meta local Diego Nieves tampoco desmereció: firmó 4 paradas, una nota de 8,1 y evitó males mayores, con casi un gol prevenido según las métricas avanzadas. Un duelo de guardametas que elevó el nivel del espectáculo. Morchiladze, mucho más que el gol El autor del tanto, Morchiladze, fue el mejor jugador de campo del Lugo con una valoración de 8,3 antes de ser sustituido en el minuto 68. El georgiano no solo definió: completó 22 de 23 pases, ganó duelos y aportó recorrido por banda. A su lado, Rufino Lucero (8) y Pablo Parrilla (8) sostuvieron al equipo desde atrás y desde el centro, mientras que Alex Costa, autor de la asistencia y generador de dos ocasiones claras, firmó un notable 7,3 pese a dejarse tres ocasiones sin transformar. En el Cacereño, los más destacados fueron Alejandro Monerris (7,4), incansable con el balón en los pies, y el central Víctor Rodríguez (7,4). El delantero Osama Chit lo intentó con 5 disparos pero no encontró premio, reflejo de la falta de puntería que condenó a los locales. Lo que deja la clasificación El triunfo refuerza el liderato del CD Lugo, que suma 28 puntos con un balance de 9 victorias, 1 empate y 1 derrota en 11 jornadas. Su solidez es tal que aventaja ya en ocho puntos al segundo clasificado, la UD Logroñés. Con 19 goles a favor y 9 en contra, el equipo gallego combina pegada y una de las mejores defensas del grupo. El CP Cacereño, por su parte, se queda con 15 puntos y un registro de 4 victorias, 3 empates y 4 derrotas, en la novena posición. Su diferencia de goles de cero (9 a favor, 9 en contra) retrata a un equipo equilibrado pero con problemas para transformar su esfuerzo en resultados. La derrota lo mantiene en una zona media de la tabla, a salvo del descenso pero lejos todavía de las plazas nobles. Conclusión El 0-1 de Cáceres es la radiografía perfecta de un líder maduro. El Lugo no fue superior en el juego, pero sí en lo que verdaderamente decide: aprovechó su mejor ocasión y, cuando el Cacereño apretó, encontró en Embadje y en su bloque defensivo las respuestas necesarias. Los extremeños se marchan con la autoestima intacta por el nivel mostrado, pero también con la lección de que en Primera Federación el mérito sin acierto no suma puntos. El Lugo, mientras tanto, sigue imparable al frente del grupo.

articles.title: Zidane: "¿Mbappé? Puede que le ponga en su posición favorita..."
articles.standfirst: El técnico galo habló en rueda de prensa tras anunciar su convocatoria
articles.summary: El técnico galo habló en rueda de prensa tras anunciar su convocatoria
articles.body: Tras tres partidos ausente en el último parón de selecciones, pues se lesionó en el debut de Zidane contra Turquía, después de anotar, Kylian Mbappé vuelve a la lista de Francia para estas dos fechas de UEFA Nations League ante Italia y Turquía. El atacante del Real Madrid, consolidado como el líder claro de la selección gala, no sabe, sin embargo, la posición en la que jugará con 'Zizou': en punta o en banda. Y es que ha sido el propio técnico el que ha hablado sobre ello. "Es un jugador que puede jugar en varias posiciones, puede que le ponga en la suya favorita, en punta, no hay ningún problema con ello. Cuando convoco a un jugador es para que juegue en su posición natural, pero Kylian ha jugado en varias", dijo 'Zizou' en rueda de prensa.

articles.title: Alabama's Ryan Coleman-Williams Reportedly Expected to Return from Knee Injury vs. LSU
articles.summary: Alabama wide receiver Ryan Coleman-Williams is expected to return for Saturday's matchup with LSU after missing the last two games with a knee injury, according to On3's Pete Nakos.
articles.body:
Alabama wide receiver Ryan Coleman-Williams is expected to return for Saturday's matchup with LSU after missing the last two games with a knee injury, according to On3's Pete Nakos .

The star wide receiver was out of the lineup after undergoing arthroscopic knee surgery to repair a meniscus injury. Coleman-Williams had already been playing through the injury earlier this season, but he underwent surgery after taking a hit to the head against Georgia that forced him to miss time.

Coleman-Williams has 23 receptions and 415 receiving yards, both of which still rank third on the team despite his absence. The third-year wide receiver also has reeled in a team-high four receiving touchdowns and made special teams contributions on kick and punt returns.

Crimson Tide head coach Kalen DeBoer also told The Tuscaloosa News that he's "hopeful" to see the return of offensive lineman Racin Delgatty. Defensive lineman Terrance Green is also expected to return. Both players missed Alabama's past two games with injuries as well.

Alabama and LSU both currently hold identical 6-2 records, and the victor of their matchup could be well-positioned to earn a College Football Playoff berth. The losing team would face an uphill battle to make it to the postseason with three losses already on their schedule.

articles.title: Haaland’s Late Strike Seals City Comeback
articles.summary: Erling Haaland scored a late winner against RB Leipzig, showing Manchester City remains a top threat in the Champions League despite recent struggles.
articles.body:
Manchester City found a way to win again thanks to a late goal from Erling Haaland. The striker netted the deciding score twelve minutes from time to secure a 3-2 victory over RB Leipzig in the Champions League. This result gets the team back on track after a tough loss to Brighton on Saturday. Haaland has now scored thirteen goals in just nine appearances against this German side, which is more than he has scored against any other opponent in his entire career.

The match was not an easy night for the visitors as City led twice but had to fight hard for every point. Leipzig scored first after a mistake by Castello Lukeba turned the ball into his own net. Ridle Baku then put Leipzig ahead again in the second half with a smart finish from a tight angle. Enzo Fernandez restored the lead for City with a powerful header from an Iliman Ndiaye cross. The game stayed tight until Haaland tapped in a low pass from Elliot Anderson to win it.

Erling Haaland proved once again that he is the man to have when the clock is ticking down. He had just three touches in the first half and looked like a bystander before the end. Yet he stepped up to score the winner when his team needed him most. Sky Sports reported that this goal marks his thirteenth against RB Leipzig. That number shows he has a special connection with this specific opponent that few other players can match. His ability to find the net in the final minutes gives his team a real edge in tight games.

Even with a win, the defensive mistakes in this game are a worry for any fan. The team gifted the first goal to Leipzig because of a comical error by Castello Lukeba. Gianluigi Donnarumma made a great save early in the second half but got beaten seconds later by Ridle Baku. Baku tucked the ball in from a difficult angle, catching the goalkeeper out at his near post. These lapses in judgment cost City valuable time and energy they do not need to waste against top teams.

Jeremy Doku came on to help spur the team into their best spell of the game. The introduction of fresh legs helped create the chance that led to the winning goal. Rayan Cherki also hit the woodwork for City while David Raum rattled the frame for Leipzig in the frantic finale. The game ended with a 3-2 score that reflects how much action both sides created.

articles.body:

In a recent story , Billy Tucker of ESPN ranked the top 40 freshmen in college football. Coming in at No. 9 on the list was USC wide receiver Trent Mosley.

"A 2026 four-star out of Santa Margarita Catholic High School in California, Mosley opened his college career with back-to-back 100-yard games before suffering a knee injury against Louisiana that cost him the next three games," Tucker wrote. "Even so, his 512 yards led all USC receivers through nine games, thanks in large part to a pair of 100-yard games against Penn State and Ohio State upon his return. Mosley showed his big-play ability against the Buckeyes , taking a screen pass 69 yards on the second play from scrimmage for a touchdown, giving the Trojans a lead they never relinquished against then-No. 2 Ohio State."

Mosley and the Trojans are off this week. They will be back in action next week for a massive road test at Indiana.

articles.title: Hosts HSV end losing streak against ten-man Gladabach
articles.summary: Outstanding goals helped Hamburger SV took all three points at home against bottom-placed Borussia Mönchengladbach on Friday night action in Bundesliga.HSV t...
articles.body:
Outstanding goals helped Hamburger SV took all three points at home against bottom-placed Borussia Mönchengladbach on Friday night action in Bundesliga.

HSV took the lead after a frantic start at both ends for ten minutes. Gladbach had decent chances via Shuto Machino and Lukas Ullrich, while there was a penalty-kick shout for a challenge on Albert Grønbæk before Patson Daka failed to penalize Joe Scally's mistake.

In contrast, the goal came from a low probability of conversion rate as Miro Muheim fires one from long range. Including his late winners against Hoffenheim and Stuttgart, the 28-year-old scored three goals in only five Bundesliga appearances after scoring once in the past two campaigns.

Daniel Batz and Daniel Heuer Fernandes then made decent saves to deny Martin Adeline and Zento Uno as the end-to-end nature of the game produced an enthralling encounter. Despite their positions in the standings, the former giants followed an attacking approach in front of Günter Netzer, who won the Bundesliga twice with Gladbach before transforming HSV in his role as general manager after retirement.

Although the onrushing Heuer Fernandes was targeted by Florian Neuhaus' ambitious attempt that followed with Merlin Polzin throwing instructions, the hosts dominated the remaining of the half as the next big chance fell to David Möller Wolfe before a wild free-kick from close range by Grønbæk.

The two players also combined for another chance before Gladbach equalized against all odds before the half-time whistle. Joe Scally's effort didn't seem to be troubling for HSV initially, but it went all the way after a slight deflection by Robin Hack.

In his first start since matchday 4, Ko Itakura was the only player that went into the referee's handbook in the first 45 minutes. The Japanese international, who returned to the club this summer after only a year at Ajax, then saw his second booking with an unnecessary challenge four minutes after the restart.

Alexander Blessin immediately decided to introduce Kevin Diks to shore up his defense, but HSV scored with their first real chance of the half. Daka couldn't reach Grønbæk's pass in the box, but 19-year-old center-back Shafiq Nandja smashed it home with great composure for his first goal in professional football.

HSV still made life difficult for themselves as a miscommunication between Heuer Fernandes and Sebastian Bornauw invited an equalizing goal before the latter redeemed himself with a last-ditch block to thwart Scally. The American defender rued his missed chance as Hamburg found the third goal with another low xG attempt.

Grønbæk added a splendid goal to his third assist of the season. The Danish midfielders first goal at Volksparkstadion was a thing of beauty as he found the back of the net with an unstoppable hit. The new Germany international Wael Mohya tried to brought the visitors back in the game, but it was too late for them as Itakura's sending off changed the complexion of the duel.

The hosts end a three-game losing run in all competitions, while Gladbach's surprising unbeaten streak similarly ended after three matches. Polzin's men momentarily climbed seven places before the rest of matchday 9 action in Bundesliga.

Hamburg will travel to fierce rivals Werder Bremen in the first Topspiel after the international break, while cellar-dwellers Gladbach entertain second-placed Borussia Dortmund.

articles.title: Kentucky vs Tennessee Prediction: Are the Wildcats Really CFP Good?
articles.summary: Kentucky at Tennessee might fly slightly under the radar, but it's one of Saturday's most important games. Here's the CFN preview and prediction.
articles.body:
Kentucky is No. 6 in the first College Football Playoff rankings, and Tennessee is No. 13. On any other Saturday, and in any other time slot, this would be the biggest game of the day, with huge SEC and CFP implications. This starts an hour before it's on, but by the second quarter, Georgia-Ole Miss and Miami-Notre Dame will both be ramping up while the Cats and Vols are humming. This will still earn a front-and-center spot, though. As good as Tennessee has been – including a relatively dominant 26-10 win over Alabama – it's coming off a 27-24 loss to South Carolina, and it's one loss away from being in a really, really tough spot to stay alive for the CFP. Kentucky got destroyed by Alabama in Week 2, but it's on a six-game winning streak. It pulled off great 35-34 wins over both LSU and South Carolina, and it won at Oklahoma. It has breathing room with just one loss, but with a rough finishing kick, beating Tennessee would be gigantic.

Tennessee has just one home game left after this, hosting LSU between road games at Texas A&M and Vanderbilt.

Kentucky gets two of its last three games at home, hosting Florida next week and with Louisville to close, going to Missouri in between those two.

Tennessee has won the last five meetings, going back to a 34-7 UK win in 2020.

Date: Saturday, November 7, 2026 Game Time: 6:15 PM ET TV: ESPN Location: Neyland Stadium, Knoxville, TN – Week 10 Schedule, Predictions – CFN Top 25 | Bowl Projections – Expert Picks: Week 10

No, Kentucky isn't as talented as most of the top SEC teams, and yeah, there are a whole lot of things wrong that need tweaking. But this Wildcat team just doesn't give anyone anything to work with. Kentucky is No. 1 in the SEC in fewest penalties and No. 1 in turnover margin. The Wildcats have only been hit with 15 penalties over the last five weeks, and they haven't turned it over in any of the last four games. On the flip side, Tennessee gets flagged an average of 7.6 times per game, and while turnovers aren't a big problem, it gave the ball away eight times over the last four games.

Tennessee has to keep the mistakes to a minimum, and it has to keep the offense moving. It doesn't have to take any big chances against a Kentucky defense that's good against the run but doesn't do much to come up with third down stops. The Volunteer pass rush is the best in the nation, and it should be disruptive in the Kentucky backfield, but it really is about the offense. Tennessee's ground game has been fantastic – it's 16th in the nation – and that's a jumping-off point.

Kentucky vs Tennessee Prediction, Betting Lines

The Vols are 6-0 when the offense generates more than 320 total yards, and 0-2 when it doesn't. Only Vanderbilt and Youngstown State failed to get at least 340 yards against the Kentucky defense. Yes, Kentucky is for real. It's well coached, sharp as a tack, and it's one of those teams that just knows how to win. But with two weeks off after the South Carolina loss, the rejuvenated Vols will make a massive statement in both the SEC and College Football Playoff chases with a strong performance.

articles.title: Eye of the Tiger: Pivotal position matchups LSU vs. Alabama
articles.summary: In a game between two very good football teams with the playoffs in sight, what matchups are key to watch on Saturday
articles.body:
The first edition of the College Football Playoff rankings came out this week and the results made this game even more important for LSU than we already knew it was.

The Tigers come in ranked #14, which feels right. Both of their losses were on the road to teams currently in the top-10, but they still lack a marquee win. While it's not LSU's fault that Clemson's program isn't what it was when the home and home series was scheduled, that Texas A&M fell off of a cliff following their CFP appearance last year, or that Kamario Taylor got injured the game before Mississippi St came to Tiger Stadium, it's still true that they haven't beaten a top team.

On Saturday, that would change with a win over Alabama. The Crimson Tide found themselves ranked #5 in the initial CFP rankings, despite already have two losses. Both teams in this matchup have a 6-2 record. As egregious as that ranking may be, it's excellent for Lane Kiffin's Tigers. They now have the chance to add a top-5 win to their resume if they take care of business at 2:30 pm on Saturday.

LSU currently sits as 6-point favorites. After falling in to the shadows after their heart-breaking loss to Kentucky early in November, they've turned it on and become one of the hottest teams in the country. National media is starting to believe in the Tigers, again, so this game is massive for a multitude of reason.

Which key positions may play the biggest role in Death Valley on Saturday afternoon?

LSU offensive tackles vs. Alabama off the edge

The LSU offense really found their stride once Sam Leavitt injured his hamstring and had to learn how to sit in the pocket. What started in that Texas A&M game has carried forward to where we are now and he's arguably playing some of the best quarterback in the entire country.

His protection has been a major factor in allowing him to find that growth. It's one thing to not be able to scramble and run because your leg is compromised, but it's another to have to make the adjustment to stay in the pocket and have your offensive line perform as well as they have for you. Though they're far from perfect, the Tiger line deserves a ton of credit.

On Saturday, Jordan Seaton and Weston Davis have important matchups with Yhonzae Pierre and Devan Thompkins. While they only have 3.5 and 3 sacks, respectively, they still find ways to affect passers. Pierre has 9 quarterback hurries, while Thompkins has 16.

Alabama's best chance of disrupting the LSU offense at home is to get to Leavitt. Even if they don't sack him much, getting him off-schedule and trying to force him back in to his interception habit could be the difference.

As he has all year, Woodland is likely to draw the role of guarding the opposing team's best wide receiver. In this case, it's Coleman-Williams. Forget the fact that he's come down to reality following a great freshman year in 2024, he's still extremely talented.

The junior wideout has been out since getting injured during Alabama's loss to Georgia on October 10th. He's listed as questionable on the injury report and it seems like he's on his way back.

In the 6 games that he has played, he's totaled 23 receptions for 415 yards and 4 touchdowns. We'll get to Keelon Russell in a little bit, but for the Crimson Tide's young quarterback to be successful in a top spot, having his WR1 back doing his thing would be a massive help.

Woodland has been tested game after game by opposing weapons and he's continued to pass with flying colors.

As a true sophomore making just the 9th start of his career, Saturday will be the toughest test, by far. He's extremely talented and been pretty good for Alabama while taking over for Ty Simpson after 2025. Still, this is a different beast.

What makes him special is the ability to throw the ball down field or run. He's proven capable of doing so against SEC opponents a few times already. His 67% completions for 2,057 yards and a touchdown to interception ratio of 15-5 is excellent.

He becomes more dangerous with his legs. He's added 251 yards rushing, a number that would be significantly higher if not for his 22 sacks. Along with 5 more touchdowns on the ground, he presents the same sort of threat as LSU has seen as recently has Byrum Brown. The body type is different, but the danger is the same.

TJ Dottery and Dahvon Keys on the second level will be important for when Russell wants to leave the pocket. Ty Benefield can also be thrown in to that group, especially considering what we've seen him do as a spy this year.

While you feel really good about LSU's ability to pressure Russell with their 4-man rush, how the Tigers are able to limit him from the second level is equally important.

articles.title: Uli Hoeneß claps back on criticism of Jonas Urbig
articles.summary: Hoeneß didn’t spare words in his conversation with journalists.
articles.body:
Jonas Urbig has not yet become the number one at Bayern Munich this season, but he has been accumulating a great track record of performances so far. However, not everyone is convinced of Urbig, despite being trusted for both Bayern Munich and, recently, the German national team. Uli Hoeneß was recently asked whether he is convinced Jonas Urbig is capable of becoming Bayern's number one, leading to quite an exchange between himself and the journalist.

"I have absolutely no doubt about it. It's a very smart decision. Jonas Urbig will get this opportunity. Everyone at FC Bayern is prepared for that. Based on his performance on the pitch and his character, he deserves this chance. Then we'll see what happens next. He has the ability to make it," Hoeneß told Welt am Sonntag , as captured by @iMiaSanMia .

"Urbig has never been the number one at a world-class club; Neuer's shoes to fill would be enormous," the interviewer said.

"So should we spend €50 million on a goalkeeper just because he's played a few Champions League games and a few know-it-alls are demanding that? Absolutely not," Hoeneß responded.

It is a perfect response to the journalist in what is truly a ridiculous counterpoint. Without taking a shot at young talent, clubs would be forced to always spend big money on proven talent elsewhere, which would not be financially feasible. Urbig seems up for the challenge and, while there are no guarantees, he is without a doubt the best option at the moment.

articles.title: Nick Saban says the upcoming 24-team College Football Playoff will include 'too many' teams
articles.summary: Teams could play as many as 17 games in a season in 2027 even with the dissolution of conference championship games.
articles.body:
Nick Saban's current employer will be televising most of the games in the expanded 24-team College Football Playoff next season. But that doesn't mean the former Alabama coach is a fan of the idea to make the playoff bigger.

The former Alabama coach and current ESPN analyst joined Jason Kelce and Travis Kelce on their "New Heights" podcast released Friday and made it clear that he believed the new playoff was too large.

"Too many, there's not 24 teams in the country that can win the national championship," Saban said when Travis Kelce asked him about the expansion. "So what is the reason to actually do it?"

"Money," Jason Kelce, also an ESPN analyst, responded.

"You got it," Saban replied. He continued.

"But what you're giving up, which is what I hate to see is the SEC championship game, playing in the SEC championship was a big thing to our players, it was a big thing to our fans, it was a tradition, and it was a great venue. There's only two teams that can play in the national championship, but more teams can play in those kind of championship games, and there's a lot of pride in winning the conference championship."

Conference championship games are largely expected to go by the wayside as a product of the 24-team playoff implemented next season. Friday afternoon, the CFP issued a statement saying that "a formal agreement between the CFP and ESPN regarding future media rights in connection with potential expansion is in the final stages of review by the CFP."

As part of a bigger playoff, teams in the Big Ten will be required to play a non-conference game against a power conference opponent. The SEC already has that rule in place as it went to a nine-game schedule in 2026 to match the other three power conferences.

If conference championship games existed, a team could play 18 games if it made the national title game in the 24-team field. Dropping the title games will give the playoff room to start earlier and max the number of potential games for any one team at 17.

"If we just put the right 12 teams in and didn't go through all the political BS that we went through so we could have a 12-team playoff, and ended up putting a couple teams in that shouldn't be in and then some other teams that should have been in didn't get in, that was a good tournament," Saban said. "And maybe you go to 16 if you want to include some other people, but 24's a lot, it's too many games for college football players to play. We played 15 games, I think three times, and I thought that was too many games for college players to play."
